title: join
description: The least upper bound of two elements of a lattice, a ∨ b — the smallest element above both. Disjunction in logic, union in sets; dual to meet. The fixed point settling reaches is a join.

operation.description: a binary operation ∨ : carrier × carrier → carrier

least-upper-bound.description: a ∨ b is an upper bound of {a,b} and the least such — its universal property
